• Cells co-ordinate to perform common function.
• Transport water, minerals and food materials.
Xylem consists of tracheids, vessels, xylem parenchyma and xylem fibres.
Tracheids and vessels have thick walls, and many are dead cells when mature.
Tracheids and vessels are tubular structures. This allows them to transport water and minerals…
The parenchyma stores food and help in sideways conduction of water.
Xylem fibres are mainly supportive in function.
Phloem is made up of five types of cells: sieve cells, sieve tubes, companion cells, phloem fibres…
Except phloem fibres, other phloem cells are living cells.
Sieve tubes are tubular cells with perforated walls.
Phloem transports food from leaves to other parts of the plant.

BIE's content types (the type of an item decides its required questions and how it is taught, shown, played and drawn):
- process · Process: Something that happens in steps or stages over time: a mechanism, a procedure, a cycle (photosynthesis, cell division, how a bill becomes law). Required questions: how (kaise), when (kab). Other questions: what (kya), where (kahan), why (kyun), consequence (nateeja).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the result first (what it makes). 2) inputs and the place. 3) each step with its cause and its condition. 4) what breaks when a step fails. 5) the whole run once more at speed. 6) recap as a flow.
- structure · Structure: Something made of parts arranged in space, each part with a function (a cell, a leaf, the heart, a machine, the Parliament). Required questions: what (kya), where (kahan). Other questions: how (kaise), why (kyun), which (kaun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the whole in context. 2) zoom into each part in a fixed path (outside to inside). 3) function of each part tied to its shape. 4) how the parts work together. 5) labelled recap.
- classification · Classification: A group divided into kinds by a stated basis (types of tissues, kinds of rocks, kinds of writs). Required questions: which (kaun), difference (tulna). Other questions: what (kya), evidence (saboot), where (kahan).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the basis of division first. 2) the tree from the top down. 3) each kind with its identifying feature and an example. 4) the borderline cases and exceptions. 5) the tree as recap.
- comparison · Comparison: Two or more things set side by side on stated criteria (plant and animal cells, Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha). Required questions: compare (tulna), difference (tulna). Other questions: what (kya), why (kyun), evidence (saboot).
  Teaching pattern: 1) what is common. 2) criteria one at a time, both sides together. 3) the reason behind each difference. 4) the most confused pair named directly. 5) difference table as recap.
- timeline · Timeline: Events placed in time: history, the development of an idea, stages of a life (the Revolt of 1857, evolution of cell theory). Required questions: when (kab), why (kyun). Other questions: who (kaun), where (kahan), consequence (nateeja).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the period and its atmosphere. 2) events in order with their causes. 3) the people and their choices. 4) the turning point. 5) what changed after. 6) timeline recap.
- cause_effect · Reasoning (cause and effect): Why something happens: causes, effects, conditions and chains of reasoning (why tissues specialise, why prices rise, why a law was needed). Required questions: why (kyun), how (kaise). Other questions: consequence (nateeja), evidence (saboot), exception (tulna).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the effect students can see. 2) the cause. 3) each link of the chain with its mechanism. 4) the evidence. 5) the exception or limit. 6) the chain as recap.
- facts_numbers · Facts and numbers: Stated facts, quantities, measurements, statistics and formulas (heart rate 72 per minute, 3,000 against 50,000 soldiers at Plassey, F = ma). Required questions: what (kya), evidence (saboot). Other questions: compare (tulna), why (kyun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) the fact in one line. 2) the number shown to scale against something familiar. 3) where it comes from (book or outside, dated). 4) what it changes or proves. 5) a formula built term by term when there is one.
- figure · Figure: A diagram, photo, map, graph or table drawing on the page whose content is visual (tissue pages 2, 7 and 8 are figures only). Required questions: what (kya), which (kaun). Other questions: how (kaise), why (kyun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) what the figure is and why it is here. 2) a reading path across it (labels in order). 3) the one thing to remember from it. 4) link back to the text it explains.
- definition · Definition: A term and its meaning as the book states it (tissue, meristem, sovereignty). Required questions: what (kya), evidence (saboot). Other questions: about (kya), why (kyun).
  Teaching pattern: 1) a concrete example first. 2) the book's definition word by word. 3) a non-example that tests the boundary. 4) where the term is used next in the chapter.

frame.process: A complex permanent tissue contains several cell types.
frame.how: Read each tissue as an organised whole, then distinguish its component cells.
frame.when: Introduce the composition before individual transport roles.
frame.conditions: Complex refers to different cell types, not simply many cells.
frame.atmosphere: Picture the paired xylem and phloem anatomical drawings.

frame.process: Different cells coordinate in transport-related work.
frame.how: Conduction, storage and support contribute to a common tissue function.
frame.when: Establish the shared work before separating the two tissues.
frame.conditions: Transported materials include water, minerals and food.
frame.atmosphere: A plant needs connected transport pathways and supporting tissue.

frame.process: Complex permanent tissues are classified as xylem and phloem.
frame.how: Separate the branches by their principal transported materials.
frame.when: Classify before studying components.
frame.conditions: Both branches contain different cell types.
frame.atmosphere: A two-branch tissue classification.

frame.process: Xylem combines conducting cells, parenchyma and fibres.
frame.how: Move from the whole drawing to conducting elements, adjacent parenchyma and fibres.
frame.when: Describe mature conducting elements when discussing thick walls and dead contents.
frame.conditions: Do not extend the dead-cell description to living xylem parenchyma.
frame.atmosphere: A magnified xylem tissue group.

frame.process: Tubular tracheids and vessels provide vertical water-and-mineral pathways.
frame.how: Their elongated organisation provides an axial route.
frame.when: During conduction along the plant axis.
frame.conditions: A pathway is necessary; tubular shape alone is not the driving force.
frame.atmosphere: Contrast lengthwise conduction with sideways movement.

frame.process: Xylem parenchyma stores food and helps sideways conduction; fibres mainly support.
frame.how: Distinguish storage, lateral movement and mechanical reinforcement.
frame.when: These roles operate alongside axial conduction.
frame.conditions: Storage does not make xylem the main food-distribution tissue.
frame.atmosphere: Conducting cells surrounded by complementary components.

frame.process: Phloem includes five listed cell types, with fibres as the living-cell exception.
frame.how: Classify components by identity and then distinguish living elements from mature fibres.
frame.when: Discuss cell vitality at maturity.
frame.conditions: The five-type list spans plant groups; it is not a universal inventory for every plant.
frame.atmosphere: A phloem component tree with a marked fibre exception.

frame.process: Sieve-tube elements form a perforated conducting pathway.
frame.how: Read the tube, end sieve plates and adjoining elements.
frame.when: Food-containing sap passes between successive elements.
frame.conditions: Perforations allow continuity through the end partitions.
frame.atmosphere: An enlarged phloem conducting tube.

frame.process: Phloem carries food from leaves to other plant parts.
frame.how: Connect food-producing leaves with consuming or storing regions.
frame.when: Food moves according to source and sink locations.
frame.conditions: The leaf-to-other-parts example does not imply universally downward flow.
frame.atmosphere: A leaf supplying growing plant regions.

frame.process: Figures connect component anatomy to tissue position and illustrated transport.
frame.how: Read upper paired drawings, lower cellular enlargements, then the plant-axis overview.
frame.when: Identify structures before interpreting transport arrows.
frame.conditions: Leader lines name structures; the red arrow enlarges a region; black arrows depict flow.
frame.atmosphere: Successive magnifications from a plant axis to conducting cells.

frame.process: Compare transport, vitality, walls, permeability, wall materials and support.
frame.how: Read both sides criterion by criterion, then qualify broad table statements.
frame.when: After components and their functions have been established.
frame.conditions: Distinguish conducting elements from all cells in a complex tissue.
frame.atmosphere: A six-row comparison table with visible exception notes.

frame.process: Identify the option excluded from xylem.
frame.how: Assign each option to its tissue and interpret parenchyma in context.
frame.when: After learning component identities and exceptions.
frame.conditions: The question asks for the exception, not a conducting component.
frame.atmosphere: A four-option exam question.

beats.say: Plant में water और food दोनों चलते हैं, तो transport tissue एक ही तरह का क्यों नहीं है? आज तुम देखोगे कि रास्ते अलग हैं, और हर रास्ते में अलग cells मिलकर काम करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Plant silhouette: water/minerals and food pathways posed as a question.

beats.say: Complex permanent tissue को पहले पूरा देखो। इसमें 1 से ज़्यादा type के cells होते हैं; केवल बहुत सारे cells होने से tissue complex नहीं कहलाता।
beats.on_screen: One tissue containing differently shaped cell types.

beats.say: Page के xylem और phloem drawings में अलग-अलग नाम वाले cells देखो। एक ही tissue के भीतर ये अलग components हैं, अलग-अलग पूरे tissues नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Highlight multiple component labels inside each tissue outline.

beats.say: इनकी बनावट भी काम से जुड़ी है: tube जैसे cells conduction करते हैं, जबकि fibres support देते हैं। इसलिए हर cell का एक जैसा दिखना ज़रूरी नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Tube-shaped conducting cell beside a narrow fibre.

beats.say: अलग cells साथ काम करें, तभी पूरा tissue अपना काम करता है। अलग बनावट यहाँ बिखराव नहीं, काम का बँटवारा दिखाती है।
beats.on_screen: Different component cells enclosed by one tissue boundary.

beats.say: तो label याद रखो: complex permanent tissue, यानी कई cell types वाला tissue। आगे xylem और phloem इसी बात के 2 examples हैं।
beats.on_screen: Complex permanent tissue → different cell types.

beats.say: Book के अगले facts हैं: ये cells common function के लिए coordinate करते हैं। Complex tissues water, minerals और food materials के transport से जुड़े हैं।
beats.on_screen: Common function: coordinated transport-related work.

beats.say: इसे पूरे plant के आकार पर सोचो: water का रास्ता लंबाई में चलता है, लेकिन आसपास sideways movement भी चाहिए। केवल रास्ता नहीं, storage और support भी साथ चाहिए।
beats.on_screen: Lengthwise and sideways movement contrasted; storage and support alongside.

beats.say: इसका evidence आगे book में मिलता है: tracheids और vessels water-minerals को vertically ले जाते हैं। Parenchyma storage और sideways conduction में मदद करता है; fibres support देते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Book evidence: conduction | storage and sideways movement | support.

beats.say: इससे common function का मतलब साफ है: हर cell को वही काम दोहराना नहीं है। अलग roles मिलकर एक काम करने वाला tissue बनाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Complementary roles converge on tissue function.

beats.say: अब मुख्य transport काम के आधार पर 2 branches समझो। Water और minerals वाला काम xylem का, food वाला phloem का है।
beats.on_screen: Classification basis: principal transported material.

beats.say: ऊपर complex permanent tissues लिखो। उससे नीचे 2 नाम निकलेंगे: Xylem और Phloem।
beats.on_screen: Complex permanent tissues → Xylem / Phloem.

beats.say: Roots से leaves तक water-minerals पहुँचाना xylem का example है। Leaves से growing parts तक food पहुँचाना phloem का example है।
beats.on_screen: Two plant routes, labelled by material.

beats.say: लेकिन किसी component में food store होना उसे phloem नहीं बना देता। Classification में पूरे tissue का मुख्य काम और उसके components देखो।
beats.on_screen: Storage in a component ≠ identity of the whole tissue.

beats.say: Tree में दोनों complex हैं, क्योंकि दोनों में अलग cell types हैं। नाम 2 हैं, लेकिन हर नाम के भीतर कई components हैं।
beats.on_screen: Both branches expand into multiple cell types.

beats.say: अब xylem खोलकर देखो: इसमें tracheids, vessels, xylem parenchyma और xylem fibres हैं। Upper drawing के left में चारों दिखते हैं; नीचे कुछ components बड़े करके दिखाए हैं।
beats.on_screen: Whole xylem with four component labels.

beats.say: पहले conducting components, tracheids और vessels, पर आओ। Book इनके thick walls बताती है और कहती है कि mature होने पर many cells dead होते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Zoom into xylem tracheids and vessels; retain the book's maturity wording.

beats.say: Dead होने का मतलब wall गायब होना नहीं है। Standard textbook explanation में mature conducting elements के living contents चले जाते हैं; मजबूत walls रास्ता बनाए रखती हैं और दबकर बंद होने से बचाती हैं।
beats.on_screen: Persistent reinforced wall surrounding an open conducting interior.

beats.say: Conducting cells के साथ parenchyma storage और sideways water movement करता है; fibres support देते हैं। ये अलग roles साथ होने से xylem complex tissue बनता है।
beats.on_screen: Conductors + parenchyma + fibres cooperate.

beats.say: Labels के साथ याद करो: tracheids और vessels conduction, parenchyma storage, fibres support। पूरे xylem को dead मत कहना: xylem parenchyma living है।
beats.on_screen: Labelled xylem recap; living parenchyma highlighted as a qualification.

beats.say: अब दिखाई देने वाला result पकड़ो: water और minerals vertically transport होते हैं। यहाँ यह काम tracheids और vessels से जुड़ा है।
beats.on_screen: Vertical water-and-mineral pathway.

beats.say: Book इसका कारण इनकी tubular बनावट बताती है। लंबाई में बने conducting रास्ते water-minerals के चलने की जगह देते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Tubular form highlighted before a vertical pathway appears.

beats.say: लंबे conducting cells plant axis के साथ रास्ता बनाते हैं। समझने के लिए tube को रास्ता मानो, water चलाने वाली force नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Pathway and driving force shown as different concepts.

beats.say: Book का evidence सीधा है: tubular structures, इसलिए vertical transport। यानी बनावट को function से जोड़ा गया है।
beats.on_screen: Book statement: tubular structures → vertical transport.

beats.say: लेकिन हर water movement vertical नहीं है। Xylem parenchyma का stated role sideways conduction है।
beats.on_screen: Vertical conductor arrows versus sideways parenchyma arrows.

beats.say: Chain रखो: tubular बनावट, lengthwise रास्ता, vertical water-mineral transport। Sideways मदद को parenchyma से जोड़ो।
beats.on_screen: Tubular form → axial pathway → vertical conduction.

beats.say: बाकी 2 facts अलग रखो: xylem parenchyma food store करता है और sideways water conduction में मदद करता है। Xylem fibres का मुख्य काम support है।
beats.on_screen: Parenchyma: storage + sideways water; fibres: support.

beats.say: Sideways को stem की लंबाई के बजाय आसपास के tissue की ओर movement समझो। Fibres को water का मुख्य रास्ता नहीं, tissue को मजबूती देने वाला component समझो।
beats.on_screen: Sideways spatial contrast and a supporting fibre.

beats.say: Book के exact clues हैं, ‘sideways conduction of water’ और ‘mainly supportive in function’। यही words roles अलग करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Highlight the two quoted book phrases.

beats.say: ध्यान दो, food store करना और food को दूर तक पहुँचाना अलग काम हैं। Parenchyma में storage होने से xylem, phloem नहीं बन जाता।
beats.on_screen: Local storage ≠ long-distance food transport.

beats.say: Phloem में अब cell types के आधार पर branches बनाओ। फिर living या dead होने की बात अलग से जाँचेंगे।
beats.on_screen: Phloem classification: component identity, then vitality.

beats.say: Book 5 types गिनती है: sieve cells और sieve tubes, इनके साथ companion cells। फिर phloem fibres और phloem parenchyma भी हैं।
beats.on_screen: Five named branches beneath phloem.

beats.say: Roles समझने के लिए: sieve elements food conduct करते हैं, companion cells सहायता करते हैं। Parenchyma storage और local movement में, fibres support में मदद करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Standard textbook role key beside the component tree.

beats.say: यह list हर plant में पाँचों साथ होने का दावा नहीं है। और book का living-cell exception याद रखो: phloem fibres को छोड़कर बाकी phloem cells living हैं।
beats.on_screen: List spans plant groups; fibres marked as the vitality exception.

beats.say: Tree वापस देखो: conducting elements के साथ companion cells, parenchyma और fibres। Phloem mostly living है, लेकिन mature fibres dead supporting cells हैं।
beats.on_screen: Phloem tree with the dead-fibre branch distinguished.

beats.say: अब phloem के conducting रास्ते, sieve tube, को बड़ा करके देखो। यह tubular cells से बना रास्ता है।
beats.on_screen: Whole sieve tube within phloem.

beats.say: Tube से उसकी wall और फिर end partition पर आओ। Book walls को perforated कहती है; end पर sieve plate दिखती है।
beats.on_screen: Zoom: tube → wall → perforated end sieve plate.

beats.say: Perforated यानी छोटे openings वाली। इन openings से sap अगले sieve-tube element में जा सकता है।
beats.on_screen: Sap crossing pores in a sieve plate.

beats.say: इस तरह elements end-to-end मिलकर रास्ता बनाते हैं। बीच की plate पूरी तरह बंद दीवार नहीं बनती।
beats.on_screen: Successive elements connected across sieve plates.

beats.say: Labelled पहचान: sieve tube, tubular element, perforated sieve plate। बनावट को food transport वाले काम से जोड़कर याद करो।
beats.on_screen: Three-label sieve-tube recap.

beats.say: Phloem का stated काम है: leaves से plant के दूसरे parts तक food पहुँचाना।
beats.on_screen: Leaves → food → other plant parts.

beats.say: एक leaf से नीचे root या ऊपर growing region तक दूरी सोचो। Food केवल leaf के पास रहने वाले cells को नहीं चाहिए।
beats.on_screen: Leaf supplying nearby and distant consuming regions.

beats.say: Page का comparison table भी यही बात दोहराता है: leaves से growing parts तक food materials जाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Connect the phloem bullet to the table's first row.

beats.say: इससे ‘phloem हमेशा नीचे’ मत निकालना। Food देने वाली जगह source है, लेने वाली sink; उनका स्थान direction तय करता है।
beats.on_screen: Source → sink; possible routes upward or downward.

beats.say: अब figures से anatomy पहचानो। Upper ‘Complex Permanent Tissue’ drawing components दिखाती है; नीचे boxed ‘Xylem structure’ और ‘Phloem structure’ उन्हीं को बड़ा करके दिखाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Overview of upper paired drawings and lower boxed cellular views.

beats.say: अगला plant-axis figure इन tissues की जगह और transport दिखाता है। पहले labels पढ़ेंगे, फिर arrows का मतलब निकालेंगे।
beats.on_screen: Plant-axis overview linked to enlarged conducting tissues.

beats.say: Upper left xylem में ऊपर दाईं ओर Xylem Parenchyma है: storage और sideways water वाला component। Broad elongated region Vessels है, जो water और minerals conduct करता है।
beats.on_screen: Trace leaders to Xylem Parenchyma, then Vessels.

beats.say: लंबे pitted region पर Tracheids है; vessels की तरह ये भी vertical conduction करते हैं। नीचे narrow component Xylem Fibres है, जिसका मुख्य काम support है।
beats.on_screen: Trace Tracheids and Xylem Fibres leaders.

beats.say: Upper right phloem में छोटे green region को Phloem Parenchyma कहते हैं। Broad Sieve tube के पास narrow Companion cell है; दोनों phloem के components हैं।
beats.on_screen: Trace Phloem Parenchyma, Companion cell and Sieve tube.

beats.say: Phloem fibres वाला label इसी tissue के fibres का है, left वाले Xylem Fibres का नहीं। छोटे arrow endpoint से कोई extra detail नहीं निकालनी।
beats.on_screen: Highlight Phloem fibres text without inventing its indistinct endpoint.

beats.say: Lower box के xylem half में isolated pink cell पर vessel elements लिखा है। उसकी wall markings pitted walls हैं; पास के narrow elongated cells tracheids हैं।
beats.on_screen: Lower xylem: isolated vessel element, its pits, then tracheids.

beats.say: Tracheids पर भी pitted walls label है, यानी यह feature केवल vessel element में नहीं। पास का grey column xylem parenchyma cell है: storage और sideways conduction वाला।
beats.on_screen: Compare both pitted-wall labels, then highlight grey parenchyma.

beats.say: Grouped xylem में broad pink cell vessel element है; पास का storage cell वही parenchyma है। Right का narrow cell tracheid है, जो vessels के साथ vertical conduction role साझा करता है।
beats.on_screen: Grouped xylem: vessel element → parenchyma → tracheid.

beats.say: Phloem half के isolated blue sieve-tube element के end पर sieve plate है। उसके पास छोटा companion cell है।
beats.on_screen: Isolated phloem element: end plate, blue element, companion cell.

beats.say: यहीं phloem parenchyma cells भी labelled हैं। Associated छोटे cell के भीतर dark body nucleus है; इसे blue conducting element के भीतर मत रख देना।
beats.on_screen: Identify phloem parenchyma label and exact described nucleus location.

beats.say: Grouped phloem में narrow companion cell के पास broad sieve-tube element है। Successive elements के बीच की transverse boundary sieve plate है।
beats.on_screen: Grouped phloem: companion cell, element, intervening sieve plate.

beats.say: नीचे left के छोटे cells phloem parenchyma cells हैं; parenchyma xylem में भी देखा था। ‘plasmo-desmata’ label adjoining cells के बीच connections दिखाता है।
beats.on_screen: Lower-left parenchyma and labelled intercellular connections.

beats.say: अब plant-axis overview में बाहर से अंदर चलो। सबसे बाहर epidermis है, उसके भीतर और vascular region के बाहर cortex; centre में pith है।
beats.on_screen: Overview path: epidermis → cortex → central pith.

beats.say: Selected vascular region में cambium बीच की narrow layer है। उसके अंदर xylem water-minerals वाला tissue, बाहर phloem food पहुँचाने वाला tissue है।
beats.on_screen: Selected region: inward xylem | cambium | outward phloem.

beats.say: Red curved arrow selected region का enlargement दिखाता है। बड़े view में left xylem के black arrows ऊपर हैं, बीच cambium है, right phloem के arrows नीचे हैं।
beats.on_screen: Red enlargement arrow distinguished from black transport arrows.

beats.say: सबसे ज़रूरी reading rule: anatomy की leader lines flow नहीं हैं। Black arrows flow दिखाते हैं, और नीचे जाता phloem arrow केवल illustrated route है, universal direction नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Three arrow keys: label leader / enlargement / transport.

beats.say: Figures text को जोड़ती हैं: कई labelled cell types, इसलिए complex tissue। Xylem half में pitted conducting cells, phloem half में sieve plates और companion cells पहचान बनाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Retain all upper component labels; contrast lower xylem and phloem features.

beats.say: अब दोनों transport tissues का comparison करो। Common बात coordination है; फर्क material, conducting cells और walls में देखना है।
beats.on_screen: Comparison table with shared complex-tissue heading.

beats.say: पहली row: xylem roots से leaves तक water-minerals; phloem leaves से growing parts तक food। दूसरी row xylem को dead और phloem को living बताती है।
beats.on_screen: Read printed rows 1 and 2 side by side.

beats.say: तीसरी row xylem की wall thick, phloem की thin बताती है। चौथी में xylem cells ‘impermeable to the water’, phloem cells ‘permeable to food components’ लिखा है।
beats.on_screen: Printed rows 3 and 4; mark permeability wording for qualification.

beats.say: पाँचवीं row xylem को lignin, phloem को cellulose से जोड़ती है। छठी कहती है xylem mechanical strength देता है, phloem नहीं; अब इन short statements की limits समझो।
beats.on_screen: Printed rows 5 and 6, with qualification markers.

beats.say: Water roots से मिलता है, food leaves में बनता है, इसलिए distribution के काम अलग हैं। Xylem की reinforced walls water transport में collapse रोकती हैं और strength देती हैं।
beats.on_screen: Material sources contrasted; reinforced xylem wall supports conduction.

beats.say: ‘Impermeable’ को पूरा water रास्ता बंद होने जैसा मत पढ़ना। Lignified wall regions और भीतर के conducting रास्ते अलग हैं; pits से भी water exchange होता है।
beats.on_screen: Separate wall region, conducting interior and pits.

beats.say: Phloem भी हर food substance के लिए खुला रास्ता नहीं है; membranes loading-unloading control करती हैं। और lignin-cellulose वाली row पूरे cells की नहीं, walls की simplified तुलना है।
beats.on_screen: Regulated loading/unloading; reframe material row as wall composition.

beats.say: Xylem conducting walls में cellulose भी है, lignin उन्हें reinforce करता है। Phloem conducting walls mainly cellulosic हैं, लेकिन fibres lignified हो सकते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Cellulose wall with lignin reinforcement; fibre qualification.

beats.say: सबसे confused pair है: conducting element बनाम पूरा tissue। Mature xylem conductors dead हैं, पर parenchyma living; phloem mostly living है, पर mature fibres dead हैं।
beats.on_screen: Whole tissue ≠ every component; persistent hollow xylem walls shown.

beats.say: उसी तरह phloem के सभी cells thin-walled या support-विहीन नहीं हैं। Thick-walled phloem fibres mechanical support दे सकते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Phloem fibre exception beside wall-thickness and support rows.

beats.say: Table को 6 checks में पढ़ो: material, living state, wall thickness, permeability, wall material और support। Main contrast याद करो, लेकिन component वाले exceptions साथ रखो।
beats.on_screen: Completed six-row comparison with concise qualification notes.

beats.say: Question है: ‘All are parts of xylem except’। Options हैं Companion cells, Tracheid, Parenchyma और Xylem vessel; exception A, Companion cells है, जो phloem में sieve-tube elements की सहायता करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Four options; highlight EXCEPT, then option A.

beats.say: Tracheid और xylem vessel conducting components हैं। यहाँ Parenchyma का मतलब xylem parenchyma है; xylem fibres भी component हैं, बस option में नहीं दिए।
beats.on_screen: B, C and D assigned to xylem; add fibres outside the option list.

beats.say: अब तुम्हारी पहचान साफ है: xylem water-minerals, phloem food। Components से function समझो, figures में arrows अलग पढ़ो, और table के broad claims को exceptions के साथ याद रखो।
beats.on_screen: Final concept map: transport roles, components, arrow key and exceptions.

replace_beats.say: Plant में water और food दोनों चलते हैं, तो transport tissues अलग क्यों हैं? इनके cells से समझो।
replace_beats.on_screen: Plant silhouette with water-mineral and food pathways.

replace_beats.say: Xylem और phloem drawings में अलग नाम वाले cells, उसी tissue के components हैं।
replace_beats.on_screen: Highlight differently labelled components inside each tissue.

replace_beats.say: बनावट काम से जुड़ी है: tube जैसे cells conduction करते हैं, fibres support देते हैं।
replace_beats.on_screen: Tube-shaped conductor beside a narrow supporting fibre.

replace_beats.say: अलग cells के काम जुड़कर पूरे tissue का काम पूरा करते हैं।
replace_beats.on_screen: Component functions combine within one tissue boundary.

replace_beats.say: Labelled recap: complex permanent tissue में कई cell types हैं; examples हैं xylem और phloem।
replace_beats.on_screen: Complex permanent tissue → different cell types; xylem and phloem.

replace_beats.say: Plant की लंबाई में transport के साथ sideways movement, storage और support भी सोचो।
replace_beats.on_screen: Lengthwise versus sideways movement, with storage and support alongside.

replace_beats.say: Common function का मतलब सबका एक काम दोहराना नहीं; अलग roles का साथ काम करना है।
replace_beats.on_screen: Complementary roles converge on tissue function.

replace_beats.say: Tree है: complex permanent tissues से Xylem और Phloem।
replace_beats.on_screen: Complex permanent tissues → Xylem / Phloem.

replace_beats.say: किसी component में food storage होने से पूरा tissue phloem नहीं बन जाता।
replace_beats.on_screen: Component storage does not determine whole-tissue identity.

replace_beats.say: दोनों branches complex हैं: हर tissue में अलग-अलग cell types हैं।
replace_beats.on_screen: Both tissue branches expand into several cell types.

replace_beats.say: Result देखो: tracheids और vessels water-minerals vertically transport करते हैं।
replace_beats.on_screen: Vertical water-and-mineral transport through conducting components.

replace_beats.say: Book इसका कारण tubular बनावट बताती है: लंबाई में transport का रास्ता मिलता है।
replace_beats.on_screen: Tubular form highlighted along the plant axis.

replace_beats.say: Evidence यही book statement है: tubular structures vertical transport में मदद करते हैं।
replace_beats.on_screen: Highlight the book's structure-to-function statement.

replace_beats.say: Chain: tubular बनावट, lengthwise रास्ता, vertical conduction; sideways मदद parenchyma से।
replace_beats.on_screen: Tubular form → axial pathway → vertical conduction; lateral branch: parenchyma.

replace_beats.say: Food storage और दूर तक food transport अलग हैं; parenchyma में storage से xylem, phloem नहीं बनता।
replace_beats.on_screen: Local storage ≠ long-distance food distribution.

replace_beats.say: Phloem को पहले cell types से बाँटो, फिर उनका living या dead होना देखो।
replace_beats.on_screen: Component identity first; cell vitality second.

replace_beats.say: Phloem का sieve tube देखो: tubular cells से बना conducting रास्ता।
replace_beats.on_screen: Whole sieve tube highlighted within phloem.

replace_beats.say: Elements end-to-end जुड़ते हैं; plate के pores रास्ता खुला रखते हैं।
replace_beats.on_screen: Connected elements with sap passing through sieve-plate pores.

replace_beats.say: Labels जोड़ो: sieve tube, tubular element, perforated sieve plate; काम food transport।
replace_beats.on_screen: Labelled sieve-tube recap linked to food transport.

replace_beats.say: Evidence: comparison table भी leaves से growing parts तक food transport बताता है।
replace_beats.on_screen: Link the phloem statement to comparison row 1.

replace_beats.say: Plant-axis figure tissue की जगह से enlarged transport view तक ले जाता है।
replace_beats.on_screen: Overview linked to the enlarged xylem-cambium-phloem view.

replace_beats.say: सभी phloem cells thin-walled नहीं हैं। Thick-walled phloem fibres mechanical support भी देते हैं।
replace_beats.on_screen: Phloem fibres qualify both wall-thickness and support statements.

replace_beats.say: Xylem water-minerals, phloem food। Components से function समझो; arrows और table के exceptions ध्यान से पढ़ो।

frame.process: A complex permanent tissue contains several cell types.
frame.how: Read each tissue as an organised whole, then distinguish its component cells.
frame.when: Introduce the composition before individual transport roles.
frame.conditions: Complex refers to different cell types, not simply many cells.
frame.atmosphere: Picture the paired xylem and phloem anatomical drawings.

frame.process: Different cells coordinate in transport-related work.
frame.how: Conduction, storage and support contribute to a common tissue function.
frame.when: Establish the shared work before separating the two tissues.
frame.conditions: Transported materials include water, minerals and food.
frame.atmosphere: A plant needs connected transport pathways and supporting tissue.

frame.process: Complex permanent tissues are classified as xylem and phloem.
frame.how: Separate the branches by their principal transported materials.
frame.when: Classify before studying components.
frame.conditions: Both branches contain different cell types.
frame.atmosphere: A two-branch tissue classification.

frame.process: Xylem combines conducting cells, parenchyma and fibres.
frame.how: Move from the whole drawing to conducting elements, adjacent parenchyma and fibres.
frame.when: Describe mature conducting elements when discussing thick walls and dead contents.
frame.conditions: Do not extend the dead-cell description to living xylem parenchyma.
frame.atmosphere: A magnified xylem tissue group.

frame.process: Tubular tracheids and vessels provide vertical water-and-mineral pathways.
frame.how: Their elongated organisation provides an axial route.
frame.when: During conduction along the plant axis.
frame.conditions: A pathway is necessary; tubular shape alone is not the driving force.
frame.atmosphere: Contrast lengthwise conduction with sideways movement.

frame.process: Xylem parenchyma stores food and helps sideways conduction; fibres mainly support.
frame.how: Distinguish storage, lateral movement and mechanical reinforcement.
frame.when: These roles operate alongside axial conduction.
frame.conditions: Storage does not make xylem the main food-distribution tissue.
frame.atmosphere: Conducting cells surrounded by complementary components.

frame.process: Phloem includes five listed cell types, with fibres as the living-cell exception.
frame.how: Classify components by identity and then distinguish living elements from mature fibres.
frame.when: Discuss cell vitality at maturity.
frame.conditions: The five-type list spans plant groups; it is not a universal inventory for every plant.
frame.atmosphere: A phloem component tree with a marked fibre exception.

frame.process: Sieve-tube elements form a perforated conducting pathway.
frame.how: Read the tube, end sieve plates and adjoining elements.
frame.when: Food-containing sap passes between successive elements.
frame.conditions: Perforations allow continuity through the end partitions.
frame.atmosphere: An enlarged phloem conducting tube.

frame.process: Phloem carries food from leaves to other plant parts.
frame.how: Connect food-producing leaves with consuming or storing regions.
frame.when: Food moves according to source and sink locations.
frame.conditions: The leaf-to-other-parts example does not imply universally downward flow.
frame.atmosphere: A leaf supplying growing plant regions.

frame.process: Figures connect component anatomy to tissue position and illustrated transport.
frame.how: Read upper paired drawings, lower cellular enlargements, then the plant-axis overview.
frame.when: Identify structures before interpreting transport arrows.
frame.conditions: Leader lines name structures; the red arrow enlarges a region; black arrows depict flow.
frame.atmosphere: Successive magnifications from a plant axis to conducting cells.

frame.process: Compare transport, vitality, walls, permeability, wall materials and support.
frame.how: Read both sides criterion by criterion, then qualify broad table statements.
frame.when: After components and their functions have been established.
frame.conditions: Distinguish conducting elements from all cells in a complex tissue.
frame.atmosphere: A six-row comparison table with visible exception notes.

frame.process: Identify the option excluded from xylem.
frame.how: Assign each option to its tissue and interpret parenchyma in context.
frame.when: After learning component identities and exceptions.
frame.conditions: The question asks for the exception, not a conducting component.
frame.atmosphere: A four-option exam question.

beats.say: Plant में water और food दोनों चलते हैं, तो transport tissues अलग क्यों हैं? इनके cells से समझो।
beats.on_screen: Plant silhouette with water-mineral and food pathways.

beats.say: Complex permanent tissue को पहले पूरा देखो। इसमें 1 से ज़्यादा type के cells होते हैं; केवल बहुत सारे cells होने से tissue complex नहीं कहलाता।
beats.on_screen: One tissue containing differently shaped cell types.

beats.say: Xylem और phloem drawings में अलग नाम वाले cells, उसी tissue के components हैं।
beats.on_screen: Highlight differently labelled components inside each tissue.

beats.say: बनावट काम से जुड़ी है: tube जैसे cells conduction करते हैं, fibres support देते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Tube-shaped conductor beside a narrow supporting fibre.

beats.say: अलग cells के काम जुड़कर पूरे tissue का काम पूरा करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Component functions combine within one tissue boundary.

beats.say: Labelled recap: complex permanent tissue में कई cell types हैं; examples हैं xylem और phloem।
beats.on_screen: Complex permanent tissue → different cell types; xylem and phloem.

beats.say: Book के अगले facts हैं: ये cells common function के लिए coordinate करते हैं। Complex tissues water, minerals और food materials के transport से जुड़े हैं।
beats.on_screen: Common function: coordinated transport-related work.

beats.say: Plant की लंबाई में transport के साथ sideways movement, storage और support भी सोचो।
beats.on_screen: Lengthwise versus sideways movement, with storage and support alongside.

beats.say: इसका evidence आगे book में मिलता है: tracheids और vessels water-minerals को vertically ले जाते हैं। Parenchyma storage और sideways conduction में मदद करता है; fibres support देते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Book evidence: conduction | storage and sideways movement | support.

beats.say: Common function का मतलब सबका एक काम दोहराना नहीं; अलग roles का साथ काम करना है।
beats.on_screen: Complementary roles converge on tissue function.

beats.say: यहाँ formula नहीं; याद रखो, coordinated transport।
beats.on_screen: Qualitative facts; no formula applies. Coordinated transport of water, minerals and food.

beats.say: अब मुख्य transport काम के आधार पर 2 branches समझो। Water और minerals वाला काम xylem का, food वाला phloem का है।
beats.on_screen: Classification basis: principal transported material.

beats.say: Tree है: complex permanent tissues से Xylem और Phloem।
beats.on_screen: Complex permanent tissues → Xylem / Phloem.

beats.say: Roots से leaves तक water-minerals पहुँचाना xylem का example है। Leaves से growing parts तक food पहुँचाना phloem का example है।
beats.on_screen: Two plant routes, labelled by material.

beats.say: किसी component में food storage होने से पूरा tissue phloem नहीं बन जाता।
beats.on_screen: Component storage does not determine whole-tissue identity.

beats.say: दोनों branches complex हैं: हर tissue में अलग-अलग cell types हैं।
beats.on_screen: Both tissue branches expand into several cell types.

beats.say: अब xylem खोलकर देखो: इसमें tracheids, vessels, xylem parenchyma और xylem fibres हैं। Upper drawing के left में चारों दिखते हैं; नीचे कुछ components बड़े करके दिखाए हैं।
beats.on_screen: Whole xylem with four component labels.

beats.say: पहले conducting components, tracheids और vessels, पर आओ। Book इनके thick walls बताती है और कहती है कि mature होने पर many cells dead होते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Zoom into xylem tracheids and vessels; retain the book's maturity wording.

beats.say: Dead होने का मतलब wall गायब होना नहीं है। Standard textbook explanation में mature conducting elements के living contents चले जाते हैं; मजबूत walls रास्ता बनाए रखती हैं और दबकर बंद होने से बचाती हैं।
beats.on_screen: Persistent reinforced wall surrounding an open conducting interior.

beats.say: Conducting cells के साथ parenchyma storage और sideways water movement करता है; fibres support देते हैं। ये अलग roles साथ होने से xylem complex tissue बनता है।
beats.on_screen: Conductors + parenchyma + fibres cooperate.

beats.say: Labels के साथ याद करो: tracheids और vessels conduction, parenchyma storage, fibres support। पूरे xylem को dead मत कहना: xylem parenchyma living है।
beats.on_screen: Labelled xylem recap; living parenchyma highlighted as a qualification.

beats.say: Result देखो: tracheids और vessels water-minerals vertically transport करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Vertical water-and-mineral transport through conducting components.

beats.say: Book इसका कारण tubular बनावट बताती है: लंबाई में transport का रास्ता मिलता है।
beats.on_screen: Tubular form highlighted along the plant axis.

beats.say: लंबे conducting cells plant axis के साथ रास्ता बनाते हैं। समझने के लिए tube को रास्ता मानो, water चलाने वाली force नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Pathway and driving force shown as different concepts.

beats.say: Evidence यही book statement है: tubular structures vertical transport में मदद करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Highlight the book's structure-to-function statement.

beats.say: लेकिन हर water movement vertical नहीं है। Xylem parenchyma का stated role sideways conduction है।
beats.on_screen: Vertical conductor arrows versus sideways parenchyma arrows.

beats.say: Chain: tubular बनावट, lengthwise रास्ता, vertical conduction; sideways मदद parenchyma से।
beats.on_screen: Tubular form → axial pathway → vertical conduction; lateral branch: parenchyma.

beats.say: बाकी 2 facts अलग रखो: xylem parenchyma food store करता है और sideways water conduction में मदद करता है। Xylem fibres का मुख्य काम support है।
beats.on_screen: Parenchyma: storage + sideways water; fibres: support.

beats.say: Sideways को stem की लंबाई के बजाय आसपास के tissue की ओर movement समझो। Fibres को water का मुख्य रास्ता नहीं, tissue को मजबूती देने वाला component समझो।
beats.on_screen: Sideways spatial contrast and a supporting fibre.

beats.say: Book के exact clues हैं, ‘sideways conduction of water’ और ‘mainly supportive in function’। यही words roles अलग करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Highlight the two quoted book phrases.

beats.say: Food storage और दूर तक food transport अलग हैं; parenchyma में storage से xylem, phloem नहीं बनता।
beats.on_screen: Local storage ≠ long-distance food distribution.

beats.say: Formula नहीं; parenchyma storage और sideways conduction, fibres support।
beats.on_screen: No formula applies: parenchyma → storage/lateral conduction; fibres → support.

beats.say: Phloem को पहले cell types से बाँटो, फिर उनका living या dead होना देखो।
beats.on_screen: Component identity first; cell vitality second.

beats.say: Book 5 types गिनती है: sieve cells और sieve tubes, इनके साथ companion cells। फिर phloem fibres और phloem parenchyma भी हैं।
beats.on_screen: Five named branches beneath phloem.

beats.say: Roles समझने के लिए: sieve elements food conduct करते हैं, companion cells सहायता करते हैं। Parenchyma storage और local movement में, fibres support में मदद करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Standard textbook role key beside the component tree.

beats.say: यह list हर plant में पाँचों साथ होने का दावा नहीं है। और book का living-cell exception याद रखो: phloem fibres को छोड़कर बाकी phloem cells living हैं।
beats.on_screen: List spans plant groups; fibres marked as the vitality exception.

beats.say: Tree वापस देखो: conducting elements के साथ companion cells, parenchyma और fibres। Phloem mostly living है, लेकिन mature fibres dead supporting cells हैं।
beats.on_screen: Phloem tree with the dead-fibre branch distinguished.

beats.say: Phloem का sieve tube देखो: tubular cells से बना conducting रास्ता।
beats.on_screen: Whole sieve tube highlighted within phloem.

beats.say: Tube से उसकी wall और फिर end partition पर आओ। Book walls को perforated कहती है; end पर sieve plate दिखती है।
beats.on_screen: Zoom: tube → wall → perforated end sieve plate.

beats.say: Perforated यानी छोटे openings वाली। इन openings से sap अगले sieve-tube element में जा सकता है।
beats.on_screen: Sap crossing pores in a sieve plate.

beats.say: Elements end-to-end जुड़ते हैं; plate के pores रास्ता खुला रखते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Connected elements with sap passing through sieve-plate pores.

beats.say: Labels जोड़ो: sieve tube, tubular element, perforated sieve plate; काम food transport।
beats.on_screen: Labelled sieve-tube recap linked to food transport.

beats.say: Phloem का stated काम है: leaves से plant के दूसरे parts तक food पहुँचाना।
beats.on_screen: Leaves → food → other plant parts.

beats.say: एक leaf से नीचे root या ऊपर growing region तक दूरी सोचो। Food केवल leaf के पास रहने वाले cells को नहीं चाहिए।
beats.on_screen: Leaf supplying nearby and distant consuming regions.

beats.say: Evidence: comparison table भी leaves से growing parts तक food transport बताता है।
beats.on_screen: Link the phloem statement to comparison row 1.

beats.say: इससे ‘phloem हमेशा नीचे’ मत निकालना। Food देने वाली जगह source है, लेने वाली sink; उनका स्थान direction तय करता है।
beats.on_screen: Source → sink; possible routes upward or downward.

beats.say: यहाँ भी formula नहीं; मुख्य fact है phloem से food transport।
beats.on_screen: No formula applies: phloem transports food from leaves to other parts.

beats.say: अब figures से anatomy पहचानो। Upper ‘Complex Permanent Tissue’ drawing components दिखाती है; नीचे boxed ‘Xylem structure’ और ‘Phloem structure’ उन्हीं को बड़ा करके दिखाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Overview of upper paired drawings and lower boxed cellular views.

beats.say: Plant-axis figure tissue की जगह से enlarged transport view तक ले जाता है।
beats.on_screen: Overview linked to the enlarged xylem-cambium-phloem view.

beats.say: Upper left xylem में ऊपर दाईं ओर Xylem Parenchyma है: storage और sideways water वाला component। Broad elongated region Vessels है, जो water और minerals conduct करता है।
beats.on_screen: Trace leaders to Xylem Parenchyma, then Vessels.

beats.say: लंबे pitted region पर Tracheids है; vessels की तरह ये भी vertical conduction करते हैं। नीचे narrow component Xylem Fibres है, जिसका मुख्य काम support है।
beats.on_screen: Trace Tracheids and Xylem Fibres leaders.

beats.say: Upper right phloem में छोटे green region को Phloem Parenchyma कहते हैं। Broad Sieve tube के पास narrow Companion cell है; दोनों phloem के components हैं।
beats.on_screen: Trace Phloem Parenchyma, Companion cell and Sieve tube.

beats.say: Phloem fibres वाला label इसी tissue के fibres का है, left वाले Xylem Fibres का नहीं। छोटे arrow endpoint से कोई extra detail नहीं निकालनी।
beats.on_screen: Highlight Phloem fibres text without inventing its indistinct endpoint.

beats.say: Lower box के xylem half में isolated pink cell पर vessel elements लिखा है। उसकी wall markings pitted walls हैं; पास के narrow elongated cells tracheids हैं।
beats.on_screen: Lower xylem: isolated vessel element, its pits, then tracheids.

beats.say: Tracheids पर भी pitted walls label है, यानी यह feature केवल vessel element में नहीं। पास का grey column xylem parenchyma cell है: storage और sideways conduction वाला।
beats.on_screen: Compare both pitted-wall labels, then highlight grey parenchyma.

beats.say: Grouped xylem में broad pink cell vessel element है; पास का storage cell वही parenchyma है। Right का narrow cell tracheid है, जो vessels के साथ vertical conduction role साझा करता है।
beats.on_screen: Grouped xylem: vessel element → parenchyma → tracheid.

beats.say: Phloem half के isolated blue sieve-tube element के end पर sieve plate है। उसके पास छोटा companion cell है।
beats.on_screen: Isolated phloem element: end plate, blue element, companion cell.

beats.say: यहीं phloem parenchyma cells भी labelled हैं। Associated छोटे cell के भीतर dark body nucleus है; इसे blue conducting element के भीतर मत रख देना।
beats.on_screen: Identify phloem parenchyma label and exact described nucleus location.

beats.say: Grouped phloem में narrow companion cell के पास broad sieve-tube element है। Successive elements के बीच की transverse boundary sieve plate है।
beats.on_screen: Grouped phloem: companion cell, element, intervening sieve plate.

beats.say: नीचे left के छोटे cells phloem parenchyma cells हैं; parenchyma xylem में भी देखा था। ‘plasmo-desmata’ label adjoining cells के बीच connections दिखाता है।
beats.on_screen: Lower-left parenchyma and labelled intercellular connections.

beats.say: अब plant-axis overview में बाहर से अंदर चलो। सबसे बाहर epidermis है, उसके भीतर और vascular region के बाहर cortex; centre में pith है।
beats.on_screen: Overview path: epidermis → cortex → central pith.

beats.say: Selected vascular region में cambium बीच की narrow layer है। उसके अंदर xylem water-minerals वाला tissue, बाहर phloem food पहुँचाने वाला tissue है।
beats.on_screen: Selected region: inward xylem | cambium | outward phloem.

beats.say: Red curved arrow selected region का enlargement दिखाता है। बड़े view में left xylem के black arrows ऊपर हैं, बीच cambium है, right phloem के arrows नीचे हैं।
beats.on_screen: Red enlargement arrow distinguished from black transport arrows.

beats.say: सबसे ज़रूरी reading rule: anatomy की leader lines flow नहीं हैं। Black arrows flow दिखाते हैं, और नीचे जाता phloem arrow केवल illustrated route है, universal direction नहीं।
beats.on_screen: Three arrow keys: label leader / enlargement / transport.

beats.say: Figures text को जोड़ती हैं: कई labelled cell types, इसलिए complex tissue। Xylem half में pitted conducting cells, phloem half में sieve plates और companion cells पहचान बनाते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Retain all upper component labels; contrast lower xylem and phloem features.

beats.say: अब दोनों transport tissues का comparison करो। Common बात coordination है; फर्क material, conducting cells और walls में देखना है।
beats.on_screen: Comparison table with shared complex-tissue heading.

beats.say: पहली row: xylem roots से leaves तक water-minerals; phloem leaves से growing parts तक food। दूसरी row xylem को dead और phloem को living बताती है।
beats.on_screen: Read printed rows 1 and 2 side by side.

beats.say: तीसरी row xylem की wall thick, phloem की thin बताती है। चौथी में xylem cells ‘impermeable to the water’, phloem cells ‘permeable to food components’ लिखा है।
beats.on_screen: Printed rows 3 and 4; mark permeability wording for qualification.

beats.say: पाँचवीं row xylem को lignin, phloem को cellulose से जोड़ती है। छठी कहती है xylem mechanical strength देता है, phloem नहीं; अब इन short statements की limits समझो।
beats.on_screen: Printed rows 5 and 6, with qualification markers.

beats.say: Water roots से मिलता है, food leaves में बनता है, इसलिए distribution के काम अलग हैं। Xylem की reinforced walls water transport में collapse रोकती हैं और strength देती हैं।
beats.on_screen: Material sources contrasted; reinforced xylem wall supports conduction.

beats.say: ‘Impermeable’ को पूरा water रास्ता बंद होने जैसा मत पढ़ना। Lignified wall regions और भीतर के conducting रास्ते अलग हैं; pits से भी water exchange होता है।
beats.on_screen: Separate wall region, conducting interior and pits.

beats.say: Phloem भी हर food substance के लिए खुला रास्ता नहीं है; membranes loading-unloading control करती हैं। और lignin-cellulose वाली row पूरे cells की नहीं, walls की simplified तुलना है।
beats.on_screen: Regulated loading/unloading; reframe material row as wall composition.

beats.say: Xylem conducting walls में cellulose भी है, lignin उन्हें reinforce करता है। Phloem conducting walls mainly cellulosic हैं, लेकिन fibres lignified हो सकते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Cellulose wall with lignin reinforcement; fibre qualification.

beats.say: सबसे confused pair है: conducting element बनाम पूरा tissue। Mature xylem conductors dead हैं, पर parenchyma living; phloem mostly living है, पर mature fibres dead हैं।
beats.on_screen: Whole tissue ≠ every component; persistent hollow xylem walls shown.

beats.say: सभी phloem cells thin-walled नहीं हैं। Thick-walled phloem fibres mechanical support भी देते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Phloem fibres qualify both wall-thickness and support statements.

beats.say: Table को 6 checks में पढ़ो: material, living state, wall thickness, permeability, wall material और support। Main contrast याद करो, लेकिन component वाले exceptions साथ रखो।
beats.on_screen: Completed six-row comparison with concise qualification notes.

beats.say: Question है: ‘All are parts of xylem except’। Options हैं Companion cells, Tracheid, Parenchyma और Xylem vessel; exception A, Companion cells है, जो phloem में sieve-tube elements की सहायता करते हैं।
beats.on_screen: Four options; highlight EXCEPT, then option A.

beats.say: Tracheid और xylem vessel conducting components हैं। यहाँ Parenchyma का मतलब xylem parenchyma है; xylem fibres भी component हैं, बस option में नहीं दिए।
beats.on_screen: B, C and D assigned to xylem; add fibres outside the option list.

beats.say: Xylem water-minerals, phloem food। Components से function समझो; arrows और table के exceptions ध्यान से पढ़ो।
beats.on_screen: Final map: transport roles, components, arrow key and exceptions.

problems.problem: Total spoken words across all 'say' fields is ~1,090 words (~8.4 minutes at 130 words/min), falling short of the card's required 9.7–13.0 minutes (1,261–1,690 words). problems.fix: Add a line in c29.2 (e.g. in b10) explaining how transport work is distributed between the two tissues (xylem conducts water and dissolved minerals; phloem transports organic food materials) and claim p011-i14#q3.

problems.problem: Part c30.3 requires questions ['what', 'evidence', 'how', 'why', 'difference'], but p011-i47#q3 ('how': How do xylem fibres provide support? -> Their thick, lignified walls reinforce the tissue and help it withstand mechanical stress) is neither explained nor claimed.
problems.fix: In b28 or b30, explain that xylem fibres provide support through their thick, lignified walls that resist mechanical stress, and claim p011-i47#q3 in answers.

problems.problem: Part c31.1 requires questions ['which', 'difference', 'why', 'exception'], but for item p012-i21, both p012-i21#q3 ('why': Why can a dead fibre still be useful?) and p012-i21#q4 ('exception': Does a living sieve-tube element necessarily have a nucleus?) are omitted.
problems.fix: In b34–b35, explain why a dead phloem fibre is still useful (its strong wall remains to give mechanical support) and note the exception that a mature living sieve-tube element lacks a nucleus and depends on its companion cell, claiming p012-i21#q3 and p012-i21#q4.

replace_beats.say: Common function का मतलब सबका एक काम दोहराना नहीं; अलग roles का साथ काम करना है। Transport की जिम्मेदारी भी बँटी है: xylem water और dissolved minerals conduct करता है, जबकि phloem organic food materials पहुँचाता है।
replace_beats.on_screen: Complementary roles; xylem carries water and dissolved minerals, phloem carries organic food.

replace_beats.say: Sideways को stem की लंबाई के बजाय आसपास के tissue की ओर movement समझो। Fibres की thick, lignified walls tissue को मजबूत करती हैं और खिंचाव या दबाव सहने में मदद देती हैं। इसलिए इनका मुख्य role support है, vessels जैसा vertical transport नहीं।
replace_beats.on_screen: Lateral movement beside reinforced fibres resisting mechanical stress.

replace_beats.say: यह list हर plant में पाँचों साथ होने का दावा नहीं है। Sieve cells gymnosperms जैसे groups में, sieve tubes और companion cells angiosperms में मिलते हैं। Book का exception भी रखो: phloem fibres को छोड़कर बाकी phloem cells living हैं; dead fibre की मजबूत wall बची रहकर support देती है।
replace_beats.on_screen: Plant-group qualification; retained fibre walls provide support after maturity.

replace_beats.say: Tree वापस देखो: conducting elements के साथ companion cells, parenchyma और fibres। Phloem mostly living है, लेकिन mature fibres dead supporting cells हैं। Living होने का मतलब nucleus होना भी ज़रूरी नहीं: mature sieve-tube element nucleus खो देता है और companion cell की मदद पर निर्भर रहता है।
replace_beats.on_screen: Phloem tree: dead fibres contrasted with living, anucleate mature sieve-tube elements.

replace_beats.say: सबसे confused pair है: conducting element बनाम पूरा tissue। Mature xylem conductors dead हैं, पर parenchyma living; phloem mostly living है, पर mature fibres dead हैं। Dead xylem conductors में living contents चले जाते हैं, लेकिन hollow, reinforced walls बचती हैं; इनके खुले रास्तों से water चल सकता है।
replace_beats.on_screen: Whole tissue versus components; hollow reinforced conducting passages persist after cell death.

beat.say: इन shapes को काम से जोड़ो। Vessel elements end-to-end जुड़कर water का रास्ता बनाते हैं; tracheids के बीच water wall के pits से जाता है। Parenchyma इस lengthwise system के साथ storage और sideways movement जोड़ता है; fibres की thick walls tissue को मुड़कर बिगड़ने से बचाती हैं।
beat.on_screen: End-to-end vessel elements; water crosses tracheid pits; lateral parenchyma and supporting fibres.

beat.say: Phloem में connected sieve-tube elements dissolved food का रास्ता बनाते हैं। Companion cell उनके काम में मदद करता है, खासकर sugars की loading और unloading में। Phloem parenchyma storage और sideways transfer करता है; phloem fibres की thick walls transport tissue को support देती हैं।
beat.on_screen: Connected food pathway with companion-cell assistance, lateral storage and fibre support.

beat.say: Isolated vessel element और grouped vessel element एक ही तरह के building units हैं। ये end-to-end जुड़ते हैं और perforated end walls से water आगे जा सकता है। Pits में secondary wall कम जमा होती है; बची pit membrane के पार sideways water exchange होता है, tracheids के बीच भी यही रास्ता उपयोगी है।
beat.on_screen: End-to-end vessel assembly followed by a pit cross-section and exchange between adjoining tracheids.

beat.say: Sieve plate के pores sap को अगले element तक जाने देते हैं, इसलिए end-to-end elements connected pathway बनाते हैं। Nucleus companion cell में है; mature sieve-tube element में नहीं। यह nucleated companion cell sieve-tube element के अंदर के काम चलाने और sugars की loading-unloading में मदद करता है।
beat.on_screen: Sap crosses sieve-plate pores; nucleated companion cell supports the anucleate conducting element.

beat.say: Grouped view की sieve plate भी transport रोकने वाली बंद wall नहीं; pores से sap आगे जाता है। Phloem parenchyma storage और lateral transfer जोड़ता है। Printed ‘plasmo-desmata’ का मतलब Plasmodesmata है: adjoining walls से गुजरते fine cytoplasmic channels, जो companion cell और sieve-tube element जैसे living cells में exchange कराते हैं।
beat.on_screen: Sap continuity through plates; lateral parenchyma transfer; cytoplasmic channels between living cells.

beat.say: ये आसपास के regions क्यों दिखाए हैं? Epidermis अंदर के tissues को protect करती है और बाहर से exchange नियंत्रित करने में मदद कर सकती है। Organ के अनुसार cortex storage या support में मदद करता है; stem के pith की parenchymatous cells आम तौर पर water और food reserves store करती हैं।
beat.on_screen: Overview regions linked to protection, context-dependent cortical roles and pith storage.

beat.say: Vascular cambium lateral meristem है: dividing cells अंदर secondary xylem, बाहर secondary phloem बनाकर girth बढ़ाती हैं। Xylem में upward movement समझने के लिए transpiration pull जोड़ो: leaves से water निकलने पर continuous water column खिंचता है। Phloem का downward arrow leaf से root जैसे नीचे के sink को supply दिखा सकता है; दूसरी source-sink positions में direction बदल सकती है।
beat.on_screen: Cambium produces secondary tissues inward and outward; transpiration pulls xylem water; illustrated leaf-to-root food route.

frame.process: A complex permanent tissue contains several cell types.
frame.how: Read each tissue as an organised whole, then distinguish its component cells.
frame.when: Introduce the composition before individual transport roles.
frame.conditions: Complex refers to different cell types, not simply many cells.
frame.atmosphere: Picture the paired xylem and phloem anatomical drawings.

frame.process: Different cells coordinate in transport-related work.
frame.how: Conduction, storage and support contribute to a common tissue function.
frame.when: Establish the shared work before separating the two tissues.
frame.conditions: Transported materials include water, minerals and food.
frame.atmosphere: A plant needs connected transport pathways and supporting tissue.

frame.process: Complex permanent tissues are classified as xylem and phloem.
frame.how: Separate the branches by their principal transported materials.
frame.when: Classify before studying components.
frame.conditions: Both branches contain different cell types.
frame.atmosphere: A two-branch tissue classification.

frame.process: Xylem combines conducting cells, parenchyma and fibres.
frame.how: Move from the whole drawing to conducting elements, adjacent parenchyma and fibres.
frame.when: Describe mature conducting elements when discussing thick walls and dead contents.
frame.conditions: Do not extend the dead-cell description to living xylem parenchyma.
frame.atmosphere: A magnified xylem tissue group.

frame.process: Tubular tracheids and vessels provide vertical water-and-mineral pathways.
frame.how: Their elongated organisation provides an axial route.
frame.when: During conduction along the plant axis.
frame.conditions: A pathway is necessary; tubular shape alone is not the driving force.
frame.atmosphere: Contrast lengthwise conduction with sideways movement.

frame.process: Xylem parenchyma stores food and helps sideways conduction; fibres mainly support.
frame.how: Distinguish storage, lateral movement and mechanical reinforcement.
frame.when: These roles operate alongside axial conduction.
frame.conditions: Storage does not make xylem the main food-distribution tissue.
frame.atmosphere: Conducting cells surrounded by complementary components.

frame.process: Phloem includes five listed cell types, with fibres as the living-cell exception.
frame.how: Classify components by identity and then distinguish living elements from mature fibres.
frame.when: Discuss cell vitality at maturity.
frame.conditions: The five-type list spans plant groups; it is not a universal inventory for every plant.
frame.atmosphere: A phloem component tree with a marked fibre exception.

frame.process: Sieve-tube elements form a perforated conducting pathway.
frame.how: Read the tube, end sieve plates and adjoining elements.
frame.when: Food-containing sap passes between successive elements.
frame.conditions: Perforations allow continuity through the end partitions.
frame.atmosphere: An enlarged phloem conducting tube.

frame.process: Phloem carries food from leaves to other plant parts.
frame.how: Connect food-producing leaves with consuming or storing regions.
frame.when: Food moves according to source and sink locations.
frame.conditions: The leaf-to-other-parts example does not imply universally downward flow.
frame.atmosphere: A leaf supplying growing plant regions.

frame.process: Figures connect component anatomy to tissue position and illustrated transport.
frame.how: Read upper paired drawings, lower cellular enlargements, then the plant-axis overview.
frame.when: Identify structures before interpreting transport arrows.
frame.conditions: Leader lines name structures; the red arrow enlarges a region; black arrows depict flow.
frame.atmosphere: Successive magnifications from a plant axis to conducting cells.

frame.process: Compare transport, vitality, walls, permeability, wall materials and support.
frame.how: Read both sides criterion by criterion, then qualify broad table statements.
frame.when: After components and their functions have been established.
frame.conditions: Distinguish conducting elements from all cells in a complex tissue.
frame.atmosphere: A six-row comparison table with visible exception notes.

frame.process: Identify the option excluded from xylem.
frame.how: Assign each option to its tissue and interpret parenchyma in context.
frame.when: After learning component identities and exceptions.
